reviews.review_msg: Mark is the best prof that i have ever had...he is brilliant, funny and very helpful.  He inspires me to persue forensic anthropology and human rights.  GREAT LABS

I loveeeeee Carleigh, I've taken her twice now and I'd take her again if I weren't graduating! Honestly one of the best profs I've ever had in uni and I genuinely enjoyed all of her classes. The sweetest, most understanding person and always gives great feedback on work. Take her class if you ever have the chance!!

I love Carleigh. I'm in 4th year and am honestly just tired of uni and ready to graduate, but I actually looked forward to her classes (and they were NIGHT classes!) I think she gave great advice in creative writing and really cares about her students. Considering how easy this course is, I learned a lot because she made me want to learn :)

He's great. The class content is emotionally challenging, but his academic focus is on Black diaspora literature and archives, so what can you expect? As a creative writing prof he is inspiring, thought-provoking, student-focused, and supportive. Fair marker. Intellectually, expect to be challenged, the poetry is highly conceptual and current.

Don't take his class if you just want to passively listen to a lecture. If your into writing and want to explore what that means than take his class. He'll give you decent feedback and give you a space to explore your own uniques writing style rather than give negate your creative experience. Yes you might have to think a little!
